_note: Casting numbers the weight path uses (decisions.md 'Shop numbers' and 'Phase 3'). A shop edits this file, never the code. Keys listed in 'assumed' are defaults to confirm with your caster.
density_source: Sobling jewellery metal-weight table (yellow alloys); 22K casting alloys range 17.45-18.24 per the Flume datasheet. Calibration absorbs a shop's own alloy.

dfm_source.ring_shank: Ganoksin, Tips for Avoiding Meltdown: 1.5 mm women's shank in high-karat gold
dfm_source.wall: Stuller CAD/CAM production standards: 0.8 mm structural wall
dfm_source.prong_d: Materialise gold design guide: 0.8 mm prong diameter

tolerance.source: With fewer than min_records cast pieces: default_pct, the spread of 22K casting-alloy density (17.45-18.24 g/cm3, about +-2.2% around 17.75) plus about +-2% for casting and finishing loss varying around its 3% default (industry quotes 2-8%). With records: sigma x the standard deviation of the workshop's recorded loss %, never below floor_pct (scale reading and polishing).
